- [LLSU.16.3] **Not the gating surface.** Most entries here are
  grammar-level — parsed identically regardless of dialect.
  The gating subset (action-level forms corresponding to
  runtime capabilities) is extracted to
  [LFCA]; only that subset
  has stable names dialect registration calls reference.
gap_reason: Says the inventory is not the gating surface, which LFCA is. A statement about the document; gating is tied at LFCA.
